---
title: "Slides"
listing:
  id: decks
  contents: slides/*.qmd
  type: default
  sort: "date asc"
  fields: [date, title, subtitle, description, categories]
  field-display-names:
    subtitle: "Reading"
  date-format: "MMM D"
  categories: false
  filter-ui: false
  sort-ui: false
  image-placeholder: ""
---

Slides go up after class. Use the arrow keys or swipe. Press <kbd>?</kbd> inside
a deck for the rest of the shortcuts, <kbd>f</kbd> for fullscreen, and
<kbd>e</kbd> for a printable view.

::: {#decks}
:::

::: {.note}
This list builds itself from the decks in `slides/`, so a deck shows up here the
moment it is added. If a link is missing, the class has not happened yet.
:::
